# Psm3ERC4626Ark
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/Psm3ERC4626Ark.sol)

**Inherits:**
[Ark](../ark.md)

**Title:**
Psm3ERC4626Ark

Ark contract that combines PSM3 with ERC4626 functionality

This contract allows users to:
1. Enter with USDC
2. Swap to sUSDS via PSM3
3. Optionally stake in sUSDS vault
4. Deposit in ERC4626 vault
The contract supports two modes:
- Direct USDS staking: USDC -> USDS -> ERC4626 vault
- sUSDS staking: USDC -> sUSDS -> ERC4626 vault


## State Variables
### psm
The PSM3 contract for USDC <-> sUSDS swaps


```solidity
IPsm3 public immutable psm
```


### usds
The USDS token contract


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable usds
```


### susds
The sUSDS token contract


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable susds
```


### erc4626Vault
The ERC4626 vault contract


```solidity
IERC4626 public immutable erc4626Vault
```


### shouldStake
Whether to stake USDS in sUSDS vault


```solidity
bool public immutable shouldStake
```


## Functions
### constructor

Creates a new Psm3ERC4626Ark instance


```solidity
constructor(
    address _psm,
    address _usds,
    address _susds,
    address _erc4626Vault,
    ArkParams memory _params
)
    Ark(_params);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_psm`|`address`|Address of the PSM3 contract|
|`_usds`|`address`|Address of the USDS token|
|`_susds`|`address`|Address of the sUSDS token|
|`_erc4626Vault`|`address`|Address of the ERC4626 vault|
|`_params`|`ArkParams`|Ark parameters|
